title: Nilla SMP
description: Client-Side Modpack for the small, friendly SMP server that offers a vanilla experience with a few quality of life improvements.
body:
**Modpack for the Nilla SMP Server.**

This pack consists of mostly performance and quality of life improvements.

Built for Fabric, Sodium, Iris and Indium form the core.

Additions to the Vanilla experience include;

- Right-Click Crop Harvesting
- Storage Drawers for clean, organized storage
- Backpacks that are simple and balanced
- Improved Anvils (reduced costs that do not increase)
- Villagers Trades that can't be rerolled
- Creeper variations (that don't break blocks)
- Elytra slots (to wear chest armor w/ Elytras)
